source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of predicting addition polymers (PDF 154).

blocks.text: Jab monomer(s) mein C=C bonds hon to addition polymerisation hoti hai, maslan ethene, propene aur phenylethene (styrene) ke saath. Aam taur par homopolymers, aik qism ke monomer se bane, bante hain, lekin kabhi double bonds wale do mukhtalif monomers ko saath polymerise kar ke copolymer banaya jata hai, jaise ethene aur propenoic acid (CH2=CH-COOH) ka copolymer.

blocks.alt: Baen panel, C=C maujood yani addition: ethene, propene, phenylethene (styrene) aur propenoic acid (ethene ke saath copolymer). Daen panel, do reactive groups yani condensation: -NH2 + -COOH se polyamide + H2O; -NH2 + -COCl se polyamide + HCl; -OH + -COOH se polyester + H2O; -OH + -COCl se polyester + HCl.
blocks.caption: Monomers se polymerisation ki qism ka andaza (topic 26.4 ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Monomers ke functional groups dekhein. Carbon-carbon double bond khul kar jur sakta hai, is liye addition polymer deta hai. Aapas mein react karne wale groups ka jora, amine tezaab ya acyl chloride ke saath, ya alcohol tezaab ya acyl chloride ke saath, condensation polymer aur aik chhota molecule deta hai.

blocks.explanation: Do (ya zyada) mukhtalif monomers se bana polymer, maslan ethene aur propenoic acid; homopolymer mein sirf aik qism ka monomer hota hai.

items: C=C monomers: addition polymers (homopolymers ya copolymers).
